profile: Niagen Bioscience develops and commercializes products based on nicotinamide riboside, a form of vitamin B3 and precursor to NAD+. Its offerings include food-grade Niagen as a dietary and food ingredient, Tru Niagen dietary supplements for consumers, and Niagen Plus products featuring pharmaceutical-grade Niagen. It also supplies pharmaceutical-grade Niagen to outsourcing facilities and compounding pharmacies for prescription injectable formulations.
